judged_text: record_for_host runs where("lower(host) = ?") on every embed request, replacing the previous in-memory-cached SiteSetting comparison, and the migration creates no index on the host column. Every reader of every page embedding Discourse comments now costs an extra DB roundtrip (plus an unindexed scan) on the hottest anonymous path, so high-traffic embedding sites take a per-request DB load increase at deploy time.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes embed host authorization from an in-memory SiteSetting check to a DB lookup: `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` now calls `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)`, which calls `record_for_host` and executes `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` on each request. The migration `CreateEmbeddableHosts` creates `embeddable_hosts` with a `host` column but adds no index, so this lookup can devolve into a full scan (and `lower(host)` further prevents use of a plain index). This is a concrete, diff-grounded performance concern on a hot anonymous path, not a functional correctness defect.
